prompt.alinti: Someone open sourced a code reviewer where a second clod checks your code before you push. So instead of clod grading its own homework, this code reviewer hands every line you change to a fresh clod. It's called OpenCodex, and it first runs free scanners for leaked passwords, security holes, and risky packages. Then, that second clod has to keep or throw out every single finding and say why. And get this, in their bug test, it caught 129 of 153 planted bugs. But the catch, it only warns you by default, so turn on blocking if you want it to stop a push. For the install command, comment, review.
